rules.description: Matches names appearing in specific contexts like '(Nachname wie Bf.)' or '(geboren am ...)' which often follow a name, capturing the full name.

rules.name: Complex Academic Titles with Spacing
rules.description: Matches persons with complex academic titles that may have spacing issues (e.g., 'Univ- Prof.'), ensuring the full name is captured.

rules.name: Richter Title Names (Concatenated)
rules.description: Matches full names following 'durch den Richter' or 'durch die Richterin', handling concatenated titles like 'RichterRi'.

rules.name: Names with Suffixes in Legal Context (Fixed)
rules.description: Matches full names following legal context phrases like 'in der Beschwerdesache', ensuring suffixes like Bakk. techn., MBA are captured.

rules.name: Standalone Names in Narrative Context
rules.description: Matches standalone names following prepositions like 'von der', 'mit', 'bei' or appearing as subjects/objects in narrative sentences, capturing full names including hyphenated surnames and suffixes, while excluding company names.

rules.name: Frau Preceded Names with Suffixes
rules.description: Matches persons preceded by 'Frau' or 'Herr', capturing the full name including suffixes (LL.M., MBA, Bakk. techn.), ensuring it's not just a title.

rules.name: Names in Legal Context (Complainant/Respondent) with Suffixes
rules.description: Matches full names following 'in der Beschwerdesache' or similar legal contexts, capturing suffixes like LL.M., MBA, Bakk. techn., while explicitly excluding company names (GmbH, AG) and locations.

rules.description: Matches names following 'vertreten durch' ensuring the full name including titles is captured, but explicitly excludes company names by requiring a comma or end-of-string immediately after the name (or a known person suffix).

rules.name: Standalone Names in Context (von ... von)
rules.description: Matches standalone names appearing in contexts like 'von ... von' or 'bei ... bei', capturing full names including suffixes.

rules.description: Matches names appearing after 'Gutachten von' which introduces an expert witness or author.
